arguments.sql:
SELECT g.gender, COUNT(*) AS heroes,
       SUM(s.full_name IS NULL) AS missing_names,
       SUM(TRIM(s.full_name) = '') AS blank_names,
       SUM(INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0) AS names_with_space,
       SUM(s.full_name = s.superhero_name) AS matching_labels,
       SUM(s.full_name GLOB '*[^A-Za-z .''-]*') AS names_with_other_characters,
       SUM(s.full_name LIKE '%' || CHAR(9) || '%' OR s.full_name LIKE '%' || CHAR(10) || '%' OR s.full_name LIKE '%' || CHAR(13) || '%') AS names_with_control_whitespace,
       SUM(NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.hero_power AS hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id AND hp.power_id IS NOT NULL)) AS heroes_without_powers
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
GROUP BY g.gender

arguments.sql:
SELECT s.id, s.superhero_name, s.full_name
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
  AND (s.full_name = s.superhero_name OR s.full_name GLOB '*[^A-Za-z .''-]*'
       OR TRIM(s.full_name) GLOB '* [a-z]*' OR s.full_name LIKE '%.%'
       OR s.full_name <> TRIM(s.full_name))
ORDER BY s.id

WITH name_groups AS (
    SELECT g.gender, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TRIM(s.full_name)) AS labels
    FROM main.superhero AS s
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
      AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') = 0
    GROUP BY g.gender
),
power_quality AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS links,
           COUNT(hp.power_id) AS nonnull_links,
           COUNT(p.id) AS matched_links
    FROM main.hero_power AS hp
    LEFT JOIN main.superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
),
duplicate_links AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicates
    FROM (
        SELECT hp.hero_id, hp.power_id
        FROM main.hero_power AS hp
        GROUP BY hp.hero_id, hp.power_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
)
SELECT ng.gender, ng.labels, pq.links, pq.nonnull_links, pq.matched_links, dl.duplicates
FROM name_groups AS ng
CROSS JOIN power_quality AS pq
CROSS JOIN duplicate_links AS dl

WITH hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT s.id, g.gender, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM main.superhero AS s
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN main.hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
      AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN (
          'Anna Marie',
          'Diana of Themyscira',
          'Howard (Last name unrevealed)',
          'Krypto the Superdog',
          'Mr. Mxyzptlk',
          'Ra''s Al Ghul',
          'Weapon XI',
          'Yurrd the Unknown'
      )
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT LIKE 'Cyberdyne Systems Series %'
    GROUP BY s.id, g.gender
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'Male'), 2) AS male_average,
       ROUND(AVG(power_count) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'Female'), 2) AS female_average
FROM hero_power_counts
LIMIT 1
